copyPanel.formula: Area = (Number of Sides) × (Area of One Triangle)
steps: 1. Decompose the regular polygon from center into n congruent triangles
2. Find the area of one triangle using A = ½ × side × apothem (height)
3. Multiply by the total number of sides

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: The Rooftop Garden
revealWordProblem.text: The firm is designing a regular decagon-shaped rooftop garden bed. It decomposes into 10 congruent triangles from the center, each with a base of 3 feet and a height of 4 feet. The garden center charges $5 per square foot for soil and plants. What is the total cost to fill the garden bed?
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: One triangle: A = ½ × 3 × 4 = 6 sq ft. The decagon has 10 sides, so it has 10 triangles: 10 × 6 = 60 sq ft. Cost = 60 × $5 = $300.

reviewCheck.stem: A regular hexagon is divided into 6 equal triangles from the center. Each triangle has a base of 6 ft and a height of 5.2 ft. What is the area of one triangle?
reviewCheck.explanation: A = ½ × b × h = ½ × 6 × 5.2 = 15.6 square feet.
choiceFeedback: 31.2 is 6 × 5.2 — the full rectangle. One triangle is half of that: multiply by ½.
11.2 comes from adding 6 + 5.2. Area means multiply base × height, then take half.
The number is right, but ft measures length. Area needs square units (sq ft).
hints: Focus on just ONE of the 6 triangles: its base is 6 ft and its height is 5.2 ft.
One triangle uses A = ½ × b × h — don't multiply by 6 yet; that step is for the whole hexagon.
Compute ½ × 6 × 5.2: take half of 6 first, then multiply by 5.2. Label it in sq ft.
reviewCheck.stemEs: Un hexágono regular se divide en 6 triángulos iguales desde el centro. Cada triángulo tiene una base de 6 ft y una altura de 5.2 ft. ¿Cuál es el área de un triángulo?
reviewCheck.explanationEs: A = ½ × b × h = ½ × 6 × 5.2 = 15.6 pies cuadrados.
hintsEs: Concéntrate en solo UNO de los 6 triángulos: su base es de 6 pies y su altura de 5.2 pies.
Un triángulo usa A = ½ × b × h; todavía no multipliques por 6, ese paso es para el hexágono completo.
Calcula ½ × 6 × 5.2: saca primero la mitad de 6 y luego multiplica por 5.2. Etiquétalo en pies².
